description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractLeaveAllocationService which provides core logic for handling leave requests, overlapping leaves, leave durations, and related utilities within an HRM system. It utilizes multiple traits for additional functionalities and defines abstract methods intended for subclass implementation.

classes.name: AbstractLeaveAllocationService
classes.description: An abstract class providing foundational functionalities for leave allocation and request management, including overlap detection, leave duration calculation, and scheduling considerations within the HRM system.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequest
methods.description: Abstract method to save a leave request and send notifications, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Abstract method to determine the status of a leave request based on day type and other parameters.

methods.name: allowToExceedLeaveBalance
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the employee is permitted to exceed their leave balance.

methods.name: getHashKeyForLeaveParamObject
methods.description: Generates a unique hash key for a given LeaveParameterObject, used for caching and identification.

methods.name: getOverlapLeaves
methods.description: Retrieves leave requests that overlap with a provided leave parameter object, considering multi-day and partial leaves.

methods.name: hasOverlapLeaves
methods.description: Checks if there are any overlapping leave requests for the specified leave parameters.

methods.name: isEmployeeAllowedToApply
methods.description: Determines if an employee is permitted to apply for a specific leave type.

methods.name: isWorkShiftLengthExceeded
methods.description: Checks whether the total leave hours for a day exceed the employee's work shift length.

methods.name: getWorkShiftLengthExceedOverlapLeaves
methods.description: Returns the list of leave requests that cause the work shift length to be exceeded for the employee.

methods.name: generateLeaveRequest
methods.description: Creates a new LeaveRequest object based on the provided leave parameters.

methods.name: getWorkShiftDurationForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the total work shift duration for a specific employee.

methods.name: getApplicableLeaveDuration
methods.description: Determines the appropriate leave duration (full, half-day, specify time) based on leave data and position in multi-day leave.

methods.name: updateLeaveDurationParameters
methods.description: Updates a Leave object with duration, start/end times, and type, considering day type and scheduling rules.

methods.name: addHoursDuration
methods.description: Adds specified hours to a DateTime object, returning the new DateTime.

methods.name: getDurationInHours
methods.description: Calculates the difference in hours between two DateTime objects.

methods.name: createLeaveObjectListForAppliedRange
methods.description: Creates a list of Leave objects for each day in the leave application range, setting durations and statuses.

methods.name: isHalfDay
methods.description: Determines if a specific day is a half-day leave for the employee, considering schedule and weekends.

methods.name: isWeekend
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a weekend based on employee's schedule.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a holiday based on employee's schedule.

methods.name: isHalfdayHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a half-day holiday.
